# The NTSC palette that tetanes-core's Ntsc video filter and PPU debug views read (Ppu::NTSC_PALETTE).
# build.rs turns it into the 1,536 bytes upstream shipped as ntscpalette.pal, checking their SHA-256.
# One line per entry, in the order the code indexes them: entry = emphasis * 64 + colour,
# where colour is the PPU palette value ($00-$3F) and emphasis is PPUMASK's three emphasis bits
# (bit 0 red, bit 1 green, bit 2 blue in NTSC terms; 0-7). The last field is the RGB colour in hex.
# emphasis colour rgb
